pages.text: Three settings: output, shield strength and matter feed. The default is the minimum, 1 MW gross.

pages.title: The Loop
pages.text: More output heats the core. A hotter core drains the shield faster, and a stronger shield costs more power. Above the red line the drain climbs steeply.

pages.title: Drift
pages.text: As antimatter is used the core grows more reactive and runs hotter at the same settings. Come back now and then and retune it.$(br2)The Controller predicts time to shield failure, to red heat, and to an empty reserve.

pages.title: Efficiency
pages.text: At minimum a capsule lasts about 2 hours. At full output it lasts about 30 minutes and returns much less energy per capsule.

pages.title: Safety Net
pages.text: The reserve bank holds the shield for about 10 minutes if the grid fails. While the reactor is loaded, a sealed EVA suit relays its alarms.$(br2)When its chunks unload, everything pauses.
